text:
Taylor (AE): Heads-up — BigCo procurement insists they must buy via GCP Marketplace and their procurement team says it must count against the Dedicated commit we already quoted. Can marketplace purchases be applied to an existing reserved commit?
Sam (Deals): Not usually. Marketplace channels are separate revenue flows. We can do a one-off offset but it needs Deal Desk + accounting sign-off.
Taylor (AE): Customer says legal won't sign corporate PO unless the Marketplace invoices offset. They're pushing for it as a procurement requirement.
Jordan (Finance): From finance perspective: marketplace invoicing, grossing, and payout timing differ. We need a reconciliation flow, SKU mapping, and clear GL handling for credit memos.
ProcureBot: Ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SD-4972 (Marketplace offset request) assigned to Sam (Deals).
Sam (Deals): Proposed controls: 1) customer provides raw marketplace invoice lines for sample month(s), 2) PSC produces SKU => internal SKU map, 3) Deal Desk approves one-off offset, 4) Finance issues credit memos monthly after reconciliation.
Omar (PSC): Technical note: GCP Marketplace SKUs often include partner/reseller markup. We'll need to normalize unit definitions and token-equivalents. I'll generate a CSV template: marketplace_sku, internal_sku, unit, token_eq. ETA today EOD.
Mina (Legal): Legal needs an addendum clause: "Marketplace purchases shall be eligible for offset against Customer's committed spend at Redwood solely upon execution of the Marketplace Offset Addendum and successful monthly reconciliation. Offsets subject to mutual SKU mapping and audit rights." Also note tax/reseller language may be required.
Taylor (AE): Customer can provide the last 2 months of marketplace invoice detail now. I'll upload to SD-4972.
Jordan (Finance): Draft reconciliation steps (for review):
```
- Each month Customer receives consolidated GCP Marketplace invoice.
- Customer uploads invoice detail to shared folder and provides CSV export.
- SalesOps matches marketplace_sku -> internal_sku using PSC mapping.
- Finance calculates offset amount up to committed balance, issues credit memo against next committed invoice.
- Disputes submitted within 20 days; unresolved items carried forward.
```
Sam (Deals): Deal Desk will need the uploaded invoice sample + SKU map + proposed legal addendum to approve. Please attach all to SD-4972.
Omar (PSC): Uploaded SKU template: https://drive.redwood.com/sales/sd-4972-sku-template.csv
Taylor (AE): Uploaded invoice samples to the ticket. Link included.
ProcureBot: Reminder: SD-4972: pending docs.
Jordan (Finance): I'll loop in @Priya (Accounting) for GL mapping. Need to know where credit memo hits (contra-revenue account vs revenue adjustment).
Mina (Legal): Once Deal Desk pre-approves, Legal turnaround for addendum is ~2 business days. If reseller is between customer and GCP, we need reseller flow checked.
Sam (Deals): Scheduling Deal Desk review once docs present. If approved, this becomes a one-off addendum; we should consider templating if this hits more customers.
Taylor (AE): Procurement is okay with addendum language as long as it guarantees offset will be visible on their spend reports.
Jordan (Finance): Visibility requires SKU mapping and monthly reconciliation PDFs. Otherwise accounting can't accept it.
Sam (Deals): Next steps checklist: Taylor to upload invoices (done), Omar to deliver SKU mapping (done), Jordan to provide GL guidance (in progress), Mina to draft addendum (will start once pre-approval).
Taylor (AE): Thanks — please ping when Deal Desk decision is in.
ProcureBot: SD-4972 status: "Awaiting Deal Desk review".
Sam (Deals): Deal Desk decision: provisional approval granted pending verification of invoice sample mapping and legal addendum signatures. Logged in SD-4972.
Jordan (Finance): Accounting accepts provisional flow; final acceptance after 1 month reconcile sample.
Mina (Legal): Draft addendum uploaded to ticket for signature.
Taylor (AE): Sent addendum to customer legal — they're signing.
Sam (Deals): Closing note: once executed we'll add a short Marketplace Offset clause to our enterprise playbook. Record precedent and template in internal deals wiki. :white_check_mark:
